qualification.start: must fail at least one behavior assertion; public tests must pass
qualification.gold: overlay reference lib on clean repo, add oracle tests, require analyze and all tests pass
qualification.negative: Each negative must compile and fail behavioral assertions; analyzer diagnostics are recorded separately and do not prove behavioral discrimination.
qualification.coverage: independent read-only review of task and public docs against oracle before sealing

scope_limitations: Pure service/domain tests in Flutter packages; no GUI, device, production storage or real identity-provider qualification.
